column1: # What each Michigan government's own website says about a program reading it. BUILD_PLAN.md section 6.
# One row per host. Read by research passes on the date shown
# gives a summary. Nine terms pages were then read in full by the radar's own reader.
# The site's robots file is a separate matter: see docs/sources/mi_agenda_robots.csv.
# result   own_pages_silent     terms-like pages were read and none speaks against automated access or reuse
#          no_terms_found       no terms-like page could be found on the site
#          access_means_clause  the terms bar obtaining material by any means the site does not itself
#                               provide. They name no robot. Held out until the owner decides
#          noncommercial_only   the terms allow non-commercial use and ask written consent for
#                               commercial or other use. Held out until the owner decides
#          reuse_needs_consent  the terms bar using or copying the site's content without the
#                               government's written consent. Held out until the owner decides
#          vendor_site          the whole site is built and hosted by a vendor whose terms cover every
#                               site it hosts and bar a collector. See config/tx_agenda_platforms.csv
#          could_not_read       the site's home page gave the reader nothing to read
#          robots_bar           the site's robots file bars the collector
#          refused              the site refused the collector's own request. Not asked again
# Only own_pages_silent and no_terms_found let a collector take a confirmed row.
# A government with two hosts is read only when both allow it.
